verdict.rationale: Authy's feature page says it can capture 2FA QR codes from major services and generate 2FA tokens directly on the device, which is the core scan-and-generate flow. Community users describe it as their everyday authenticator for most 2FA accounts. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the QR enrollment flow, explicit evidence that codes are available immediately after scanning, independent hands-on corroboration of QR scanning specifically.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can scan a QR code and immediately start generating TOTP codes for a new account

citations.quote: Easily capture 2FA QR codes from Facebook, Amazon, Google, Microsoft, Dropbox and many more.
Avoid SMS and voice security issues by generating 2FA tokens directly on the device.
User uses Authy for all their 2FA accounts and calls it awesome.
